append: Uno Minda's exact-code listing for S11404-000M00 identifies a lever combination switch for Tata Prima and lists compatibility as SIGNA / PRIMA. This does not substantiate the current Tata 1109/1210/1312/1512 tags. Confirm coupler, stalk functions and column interface. Source: https://unomindakart.com/product/uno-minda-s11404-000m00-lever-combination-switch-for-tata-prima

Uno Minda's 4W Switch Catalogue 2022 lists multiple TD-4006 variants: a 24V HCV Universal–Tata switch with four inline terminals and 2500A/10-sec rating; a separate 12V, 2-pole LCV/MCV/MUV/marine variant; and TD-4006N as a 24V, 2-pole Fuel Tanker switch. Uno Minda's current TD-4006 product page also describes universal fuel-tanker/Viking CNG use, so the fuel-tanker wording is not by itself proof of an N suffix. The catalogue and product-page descriptions leave the exact variant ambiguous. Verify the physical label, terminal layout, voltage and current rating before confirming the Souviks title/application. Sources: https://unomindakart.com/catalog/open/32/Switch%20Catalogue%20-%204W.pdf ; https://unomindakart.com/product/uno-minda-td-4006-battery-cutoff-switch--4-inline-terminals--24v--2500amp.-10-sec.-for-universal-fuel-tankers-set-of-1

Uno Minda's 4W Switch Catalogue 2022 indexes exact code TD-1019 as a 12V/2-pole air-intake sensor for Maruti Suzuki MPFI 800 / Omni / Wagon R / Esteem / Zen / Baleno / Altura.
